info.name: CircleCI REST API v1 Artifact Runner Task API

params.name: resource-class
params.description: The resource class to query unclaimed tasks for

items.docs: Returns the number of unclaimed tasks for a given resource class. This endpoint is scoped to a single resource class, so it must be called per resource class to get totals across all classes.

params.name: resource-class
params.description: The resource class to query running tasks for

items.docs: Returns the number of running tasks for a given resource class. This endpoint is scoped to a single resource class, so it must be called per resource class to get totals across all classes.
